owner_authorization.purpose: Personal learning: efficient owner/agent/dedicated-layout-service workflow, not preservation of sunk cost or aesthetic optimization.
owner_authorization.later_trials: Qualified comparable four/six-layer inputs; eight layers only if little additional preparation/review and confirmed free.
not_authorized: Public redistribution of Quilter native output without license review

source.identity_policy: Preserve complete footprint/pad definitions, duplicate and unnumbered pads, UUIDs, nets, values, MPNs, DNP/assembly flags and schematic. No part substitutions.

fixed_interfaces.pose_source: Exact accepted native footprint poses, not older landmarks or proxy centers.
fixed_interfaces.board_outline: Exact native Edge.Cuts including contact tabs and USB tongue; nominal D43 is not an outline substitute.
fixed_interfaces.mechanics: Retain mounts, USB mating/service paths, connector access, speaker/height and conductive battery-contact envelopes. New placement requires exact mechanical rebind before acceptance.

initial_process_seeds.reason: Preserve mandatory process-via geometry without falsely assuming Quilter can move a footprint and its independent vias as a rigid group.
initial_process_seeds.geometry_source: Exact current PCB; verify against reports/imu-closure-acceptance.json and reports/c24-filled-via-acceptance.json.
initial_process_seeds.alternative: Relocatable seed or ordinary-via substitution requires separate explicit engineering review; do not silently delete these obligations.

functional_groups.intent: Fixed mechanical interfaces; raw negative is not system ground.
Movable MCU and complete supply/return cells. Associate capacitors with exact source pins, not all with U2.
Move with MCU relationship; short crystal paths, actual 15pF load capacitors, keep noisy switching copper away.
Local QSPI and flash supply/return, retain boot recovery branch and short test stubs.
Fixed X6; movable termination/CC parts and probe pads. USB approximately 90ohm differential, referenced to real stackup.
Local dual-supply decoupling; C24 process seed fixed initially. Record any IC4 rotation for sensor-to-bell frame mapping.
Local regulator input/output capacitors with short ground returns.
Retain charge program, enable access and indication; near fixed USB/power interfaces without imposing an invented region size.
Keep source selection and paired load/return corridors; preserve corrected custom Q3 lands.
Power gating and default-off behavior; coordinate with boost input and source selection.
Tight input and output switching loops; C27/C28 local paired returns; quiet R24-to-C28 pickoff; C29 remains DNP.
Preserve separate CELL_NEG, PROT_FET_RETURN and GND; no shunt/FET bypass; independent R26-to-R27 quiet pickup.
U4 seed/J1 fixed initially; local PVDD return and paired speaker paths. VO+/VO- are class-D outputs, not a 100ohm data pair.
Fixed connector, movable input filter with local ground.
Retain status function; no unqualified external visibility promise.
Retain SWD recovery access and usable service-pad placement.

placement_encoding.movable_policy: Every reference not in fixed_interfaces or initial_process_seeds is eligible for XY/rotation changes on F, subject to height, access, footprint, return and electrical constraints.
placement_encoding.staging: Move eligible footprints outside outline only on isolated input; preservation of source definitions and all pads must be proved after translation.
placement_encoding.front_requirement: Associate all movable references with actual F.Cu placement regions. A single-sided result filter is not enforcement.
placement_encoding.grouping: Prefer broad anchored groups and source-pin associations; do not copy the old tightly packed floorplan as restrictive rooms.
placement_encoding.unqualified: Exact region geometry, height-class keepouts, group association behavior and region intersections need native/import controls before submission.

copper_policy.diagnostic_track: Do not change or refill raw outputs. Measure actual cached copper.
copper_policy.fresh_track: Proposed removal of existing ordinary tracks/vias/pours is confined to new disposable input after fixed/process seed and keepout classification. Preserve five exact process vias and all footprint copper.
copper_policy.keepouts: Classify fixed mechanical versus component-relative electrical exclusions. Do not retain obsolete coordinate-bound crystal/private-return holes as if they followed moved parts; do not simply discard the underlying requirements.
copper_policy.same_net_private_paths: Whole-net continuity is insufficient for R26/R27 and R24/C28; require native cut/topology proofs or preserve an explicitly reviewed small circuit block if service cannot express the duty.

minimum_geometry_contract.width_policy: Preserve engineering net intent; current/path-specific widths and actual stackup impedance govern. No generic 500mA defaults or imported weaker minima as waivers.

stackup_study.qualification: Actual named supplier construction, copper weights, dielectric thickness/properties and layer roles required before impedance-dependent routing. No invented stackup.
stackup_study.more_layers: Define explicit ground adjacency and paired power/return strategy for each construction; more copper layers do not remove through-via contact restrictions.
stackup_study.comparison: Same outline/BOM/requirements/minima. Placement may adapt by stackup; outcomes do not isolate layer count alone.

submission_gates: Native prepared input proves all 104 refs/325 physical pad identities and exact fixed/process seed poses.
Source-bound height/contact/USB/hole keepouts are encoded and tested; source rules and old exclusion intent are accounted for.
Exact capacitor-to-pin, crystal, boost, private-return, USB and audio comprehensions are reviewed rather than accepted from prior inference.
Verify actual parsed F-only/group/keepout behavior; unsupported requirement gets an explicit preserve/check disposition.
Named actual stackup and saved fabrication minima are recorded.
Owner account confirms free personal job; stop at any payment or changed terms requiring owner action.
Submission uses sanitized public design only; no KiCad preferences or credentials.
acceptance: No automatic integration regardless of vendor completion percentage.
Fresh layout judged by intended pad/net identity, complete connectivity, mechanical fit, electrical/topology/return behavior and process requirements, not old trace equality.
Matched-context native DRC/parity plus independent all-layer checks; do not conceal weaker returned rules.
Record setup/review/correction effort, agent expense if measurable, actual job price and wall time separately.
Rebind selected exact placement to mechanical assembly before acceptance; no fabrication or powered approval.
